title: Figure 44: imaginary acoustic pressure contours at 5000 Hz, radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 contour plot of the imaginary component of pressure (Pa) for 5,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water, showing many fine concentric wave rings across the quarter-circle domain; legend -3558 to 2950 Pa. From the BAASS underwater acoustic propagation analysis.
